title: biodiversitycellatlas/bca_preprocessing pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the samplesheet provided with params.input. Each row gives its reads either as FASTQs (fastq_cDNA, fastq_BC_UMI, optionally fastq_indices) or as unaligned CRAM/BAM files (cram). The paths are not checked for existence here: relative paths are read from the samplesheet's folder, which PIPELINE_INITIALISATION resolves and checks.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_cDNA.errorMessage: The cDNA FASTQ must be given, cannot contain spaces and must end in '.fastq.gz', '.fq.gz', '.fastq' or '.fq'

fastq_BC_UMI.errorMessage: The barcode/UMI FASTQ must be given, cannot contain spaces and must end in '.fastq.gz', '.fq.gz', '.fastq' or '.fq'

fastq_indices.errorMessage: The index FASTQ(s) cannot contain spaces; a glob such as 'name_I*' is allowed

cram.errorMessage: The unaligned CRAM/BAM file(s) instead of the FASTQs cannot contain spaces and must end in '.cram' or '.bam'; a glob is allowed

expected_cells.errorMessage: Expected cells must be a positive whole number

manual_cutoff.errorMessage: The manual cutoff must be a positive whole number of UMIs

qc_report.errorMessage: The qc_report group cannot contain spaces; leave it empty for a sample of its own

filtering_report.errorMessage: The filtering_report group cannot contain spaces; leave it empty for a sample of its own
